glyphs.note: The original is 副, not 迎: 一副寂寞的样子, 这副模样 and 那副德行. Genuine 迎 at 067C remains unchanged.
The original has 莫 below 宀, not 宾. All three occurrences form 寂寞.
The original is 虑, not 唱. Its twelve occurrences include 考虑, 深思熟虑, 深谋远虑 and 顾虑.
The original is 忄 plus 灰, not 慨. All eight occurrences form 恢复.
The source is correctly read as 选. V32 redraws Traditional 選 to separate its two 巳 components.
The original bitmap has 忄 and 曼, not OCR candidate 𠎠. Its 38 occurrences include 慢/普通/快 speed labels and 慢慢走吧.
The original is 扌 plus 乃, not 护. Its 18 occurrences include 扔掉吧 and discarded cards. Genuine 护 at 3ABB remains unchanged.
The original has 甫, 方 and 攵, not 敖. Its five occurrences name 倉敷 and 倉敷卡.
The lower component is 毛, not 里. Its 32 occurrences include 毫无意义, 毫无顾虑 and 毫不在乎. Genuine 童 at 3ACB and 3B45 remains unchanged.
The original has a left 口 component plus 麻, not standalone 麻. All 19 occurrences are dialogue particles, including 就是嘛, 挺有趣的嘛 and 干嘛. Genuine 麻 at 056B is unchanged.
The original is 广 with 坐, not 率. Contexts include 整座岛, 每座水族馆, 这座都市 and 一座城. Genuine 率 at 038D remains unchanged in 收益率, 概率 and 效率.
Original bitmap has 竹 over 相: 箱, not 稍. Used in 千两箱, 箱子 and 一箱. Genuine 稍 at 3943 is unchanged.
The original is 涮 in 章鱼涮锅店. Mapping is correct; v17 redraws the glyph rather than using the small fallback.
The original has 艹, 罒 and 者, not 著. All five occurrences refer to potatoes or sweet potatoes: 马铃薯田, 福薯店, 红薯田, 红薯 and 马铃薯. Genuine 著 from 着 conversion is unchanged.
The original right component is the bent upper stroke and 卩/又 of 服, not 殳 of 股. All 22 occurrences include 克服, 舒服, 服务, 说服, 佩服 and 征服. Genuine 股 at 3A94 has 11 occurrences and remains unchanged.
The interior is 口, not 日 as in 间. Its 13 occurrences include 问题, 请问, 询问, 顾问 and 问答. Genuine 间 at 37F2 remains unchanged, including 时间问题.
The original right component is 凶, not 区. The 小仓 description reads 玄界滩的汹涌大海; Traditional output is 洶湧. This overrides the earlier incorrect 沤 review.
The original left component is 饣, not 十. This property is 馎饦锅店 (ほうとう), Traditional 餺飥鍋店; genuine 博 code 02B6 is unchanged.
The original right component is 乇, not 壬. Paired with 3B4D in 馎饦锅店; Traditional output is 飥.
The original bitmap is the raised Japanese long-vowel mark, not 一. Its 126 occurrences extend exclamations including 不对啦ーーー; genuine 一 code 0061 remains unchanged.
The original bitmap shows 汤, not OCR candidate 涵. Its 35 occurrences across 33 text records include 全都泡汤了, 汤头, 高汤, 汤布院, and 汤泽; Traditional output is 湯.
The original bitmap shows 极, not OCR candidate 板. Its 44 occurrences include 极好的卡, 积极, 极限, and 极为罕见; Traditional output is 極.
